contract: The app blueprint: skeleton + graphic motion planned for THIS product before any Dart. App level once; then every screen in scope gets its skeleton (skills/fluttergo-app-skeletons) and its motion recipe (skills/fluttergo-motion-system/references/screen-recipes.md): one signature graphic moment, an ordered entrance, feedback on every tappable, loading/empty/error, reduced fallback - built from lib/motion. Splash and onboarding are screens too.

app.concept: FlutterGo Demo Tutorial is a clear morning desk for daily habits — people open it to tick today's rituals and watch a day ring fill (tutorial clarity, not ritual hearth or boutique shop).
app.look: Mist dawn blue desk + citrus leaf green accent; Sora display + Plus Jakarta Sans UI (fresh instructional, not charcoal/coral, sidewalk/amber, or chalk/indigo)
app.motion_style: springy — check pops and ring bounce for a playful tutorial demo
app.navigation: none — single Home shell with header Settings gear and FAB Add (three-screen product, not tab bar)
app.onboarding_flow: welcome — one hero of habit chips + Get started (no account)
app.page_transition: slideUp — Add habit rises like a sheet; Settings sharedAxisX
app.signature_move: day ring fill — AppCheckCircle pops, AppProgressRing fills, streak AppCountUp ticks

background_rule: Clean, plain backgrounds: solid surface colour, no ambient floors, blobs, grids or decorative boxes. Motion lives in the content (signature moment, entrance, feedback).

splash.signature: AppSplash: glow bloom, mark pop + turn, name rise, tagline fade, then route

onboarding.signature: habit chip stack on morning photo — ghost tap checks one chip, day ring peeks

home.skeleton: H1 metric — day progress ring hero + habit checklist rows
home.signature: day ring fill — toggling a habit animates AppCheckCircle, AppProgressRing, and streak AppCountUp
home.empty: friendly empty with Add habit CTA

add_habit.skeleton: F1 form — name field, icon chips, save
add_habit.signature: icon chip pop on select; save button status

settings.signature: rows stagger in; reduce-motion toggle with AppPressable
